resources.string: "Harmless marker reflection; reports HTML/attribute/JavaScript context, never execution."
"Apostrophe and benign control; no extraction or time-delay SQL."
"Unique reserved-domain target; external Location is not followed."
"Two distinct origins must both be reflected with credentials enabled."
"Two harmless arithmetic expressions and a literal control; no function calls or commands."
"Encoded line-break marker compared with a harmless control."
"Unique X-Forwarded-Host markers with no-cache headers; no shared-cache retrieval or poisoning."
"Bounded method discovery and credential-free TRACE marker reflection."
"Numeric points only; repeated baseline/true/false pairs. Tentative lead, no delays or extraction."
"Cache headers on authenticated or sensitive responses; no cache poisoning."
"Private-key blocks are redacted; stack traces and debug pages are heuristic observations."
"State-changing forms and apparent token absence; no form submission."
"Source and dangerous-sink patterns; does not execute JavaScript or prove dataflow."
"Submits only your configured callback address; an HTTP response is not proof of a callback."
